body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Fire Damage and suppress 1 point of its next ordinary Damage reduction until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Your next damaging Magecraft card against that target gains +1 on its Success Die until the start of your next turn.
End one ordinary concealment effect on the target after a hit.

rider.title: Fire Thread
rider.html: Gain a Fire Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: one target that already took Damage since its last turn takes +1 Damage from that card if hit.
